title: Net benefit, calibration, threshold selection, and training objectives for algorithmic fairness in healthcare
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical evaluation of algorithmic fairness metrics (such as calibration and parity) within healthcare predictive models. While fairness is an ethical concept, the paper approaches it through the lens of utility-theoretic statistics and optimization on clinical tabular data rather than benchmarking moral reasoning, religious values, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
